title: Dark GUI Overlay
description: Dark GUI for Minecraft 1.21 and up!
body:
## Dark GUI for Minecraft versions 1.21 and up!

### Adds a darker look to all containers in Minecraft.
![Large Chest](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2949bfc640f5485bc522f22bc3a15bb47595a965_0.webp)

## How to install:
- Download the pack
- Press Windows + R and enter: %appdata%/.minecraft/resourcepacks
- Drag and drop the pack folder in there
- Launch up the game and select the pack
